propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls that default to max_results=50, silently truncating projects with more than 50 issues
issues beyond the first 50 appear to have no links, causing spurious link-creation mutations and inability to detect link removals
comment sync is silently incomplete for issues beyond page 50, with no error raised and pass converging to false success
search_issues pagination must advance by len(batch) returned and terminate only on empty page, not by requested size, because Jira DC silently truncates maxResults above server limits
get_parent_map already has this bug fixed but uses hand-rolled pagination, creating maintenance risk if fourth caller defaults to max_results=50 again
three whole-project readers must route through one shared _paged_search helper to prevent future instances and ensure consistent pagination behavior
